description: Expose the same Rust numerical implementation to R and Julia with explicit ownership, exact transport and installed-artifact parity. R and Julia are independent delivery branches.
external_dependencies: R/extendr/rextendr and Julia/native artifact toolchains: recheck documented host support and package terms at implementation.
Existing MCHS and Voiage binding work: reuse qualified patterns where appropriate without importing their domain equations or assuming their matrices apply.
completion_evidence: The R wrapper calls the core directly and can be completed without the C ABI, Julia or Python bindings.
The C ABI specifies buffer lengths, ownership/free symmetry, errors, version negotiation and panic containment; no Rust layout/unwinding crosses it.
Julia calls the qualified ABI without requiring Python or R.
Installed R/Julia results match the same independent exact fixtures and reject invalid/missing values according to documented host conventions.
Host GC, lifetime and thread restrictions are exercised rather than inferred from a successful source build.
Only installed and tested platform combinations are advertised.
